This statement is correct. Galvanic cells (also called voltaic cells) harness spontaneous redox reactions to produce electrical energy. The negative Gibbs free energy change (ΔG < 0) indicates spontaneity.

This statement is correct. Electrolytic cells use electrical energy to drive non-spontaneous chemical reactions (ΔG > 0). This is essentially the opposite of a galvanic cell.
